per_candidate.id: s2:Core structures of vortices in Ginzburg-Landau theory for neutron <mml:math xml, 2022-03-28

rationale: None of the candidate papers directly investigate the axial anomalous contributions to neutrino pair-breaking losses or the effective masses of spin-polarized neutrons in the context of neutron star stability and evolution. They focus on related topics such as superfluidity and magnetic fields in neutron stars.
